App Name Generator

Invent brandable app names — syllable blending, prefix/suffix fusion, and compound styles like 'Snaply' or 'TaskForge'.

Always check trademark and domain availability before using a name.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter a keyword (optional).
  2. Pick a naming style.
  3. Generate and click any name to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What naming styles are there?

Three styles: Blend (fused syllables), Compound (two words, one name), and Suffix (root + -ly/-ify/-io).

Can I use my own keyword?

Type a keyword (like 'task' or 'photo') and the generator builds names around it.

How many names per click?

8 names per click, all unique in the batch.

How do I copy a name?

Click any name to copy it.
